key_reasoning.reason: Touches types/entity/mcp.ts, the shared mcpStore (cloneConfig + MCPConfigCloneResponse, also consumed elsewhere via getCachedConfig), two new abstractions (MCPCopyValuesDialog component + useMCPCopyValuesDialog hook), MCPServerActions, useMCPManagement, MCPManagementPage, MCPServerModal, and columnRenderers.tsx — 9 components across the store, hooks and UI component layers.

Clone flow surfaces potentially sensitive config values (headers/env/args/url-query that may hold tokens, secrets, credentials) with only a heuristic regex (isSensitiveKey) flagging them for the user; no pre-existing reusable util covered this exact copy-values/sensitive-hint pattern before this change, so it is treated as a security-sensitive divergence.

13 files changed, 921 insertions(+) per diffstat: ~9 modified (mcp.ts types, mcp.ts store, mcp.test.ts, MCPServerActions.tsx + its accessibility test, useMCPManagement.ts + its test, MCPManagementPage.tsx, MCPServerModal/index.tsx, columnRenderers.tsx) and ~4 new (MCPCopyValuesDialog/index.tsx, useMCPCopyValuesDialog.ts, and two new test files), spanning store/, types/entity/, and three directories under pages/settings/administration/.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped: change touches the shared mcpStore (cloneConfig, MCPConfigCloneResponse) which is also consumed elsewhere via getCachedConfig — a core shared utility.

Technical Risk bumped: feature handles secret/credential-shaped values (clone copy-values selection) with only heuristic sensitive-value detection, a security-sensitive surface with no prior exact precedent in this repo.
